paragraphs: Abba Yosi ben Abai — [Zevachim 97a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.97a.7). See his entry.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Zevachim has Rabbi Yochanan transmitting in the name of Abba Yosi ben Abba. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1996&lang=en) records Abai at this locus and proposes reading Abai where another passage has a form of Abba. Hyman’s short notice gives Abai.
